notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to yourself.
You control a basic Forest.
description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Growth-Chamber Guardian by paying {1}{G}.
Growth-Chamber Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each of your creatures.
Growth-Chamber Guardian triggers, holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Growth-Chamber Guardian, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Growth-Chamber Guardian, adding {C}{C}.
Wheel of Sun and Moon causes Growth-Chamber Guardian to be put on the bottom of your library instead of your graveyard.
Resolve the Growth-Chamber Guardian trigger from step 4, searching your library for Growth-Chamber Guardian and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.
